question: Fiat money aur legal tender kya ek hi cheez hain?
essence: Fiat value ka basis batata hai; legal tender official acceptance status batata hai.
answer: Legal tender woh money hai jise government apne territory mein debts aur transactions settle karne ke liye officially recognise karti hai. Fiat money ki definition government authority aur public trust par based hai. Book legal tender ke liye 'must be Fiat Money' likhti hai, lekin Bitcoin exception bhi deti hai; isliye is line ko exception-free universal rule na banayein. [p004]
deep_dive: Book ke mutabik Bitcoin fiat nahi tha, phir bhi El Salvador mein 2024 tak legal tender tha. Supplied text 2025 reforms ke baad ownership aur voluntary use ko legal batata hai, lekin practical sense mein compulsory legal tender nahi. Yeh dated book account hai; independently checked current update nahi. [p004]
